zh-CN.title: 外部分享和媒体预览更顺滑
items: 广场里的抖音和小红书分享封面与卡片边缘贴合，重复标题只显示一次。
媒体预览在默认和沉浸模式间切换时，背景和控件平滑过渡。

en.title: Cleaner media shares and smoother previews
items: Douyin and Xiaohongshu covers fit their cards in Square, and repeated titles appear once.
The background and controls transition smoothly between default and immersive media viewing.
